```plato

    //==
    // # The particle step
    //
    // Integrator: SEMI-IMPLICIT (symplectic) EULER — advance the velocity with
    // the acceleration first, then advance the position with the NEW velocity
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Semi-implicit_Euler_method). It costs
    // exactly what explicit Euler costs and reads almost the same, but it
    // conserves energy over a closed orbit instead of spiralling outwards,
    // which is the difference between an attractor that holds particles and one
    // that slowly loses them. It is chosen here rather than Verlet because
    // `Particle3D` stores a velocity: Verlet wants a previous position, which
    // is the state `ClothVertex` carries instead (`cloth.library.plato`).

    // One step of a spatial particle under a given acceleration. Age advances
    // by the step; nothing here tests Lifetime, so a step never removes a
    // particle — `LiveParticles` does that.
    Step(self: Particle3D, acceleration: Vector3D, dt: Duration): Particle3D
    {
        var velocity = self.Velocity + acceleration * dt.Seconds;
        return Particle3D(
            self.Position + velocity * dt.Seconds,
            velocity,
            self.Age + dt,
            self.Lifetime,
            self.Size,
            self.Color,
            self.Rotation + new Angle(self.AngularVelocity.RadiansPerSecond * dt.Seconds),
            self.AngularVelocity,
            self.Mass);
    }

    // One step of a planar particle under a given acceleration.
    Step(self: Particle2D, acceleration: Vector2D, dt: Duration): Particle2D
    {
        var velocity = self.Velocity + acceleration * dt.Seconds;
        return Particle2D(
            self.Position + velocity * dt.Seconds,
            velocity,
            self.Age + dt,
            self.Lifetime,
            self.Size,
            self.Color,
            self.Rotation + new Angle(self.AngularVelocity.RadiansPerSecond * dt.Seconds),
            self.AngularVelocity,
            self.Mass);
    }

    // How far through its life a particle is, in [0, 1]: the parameter
    // `ParticleEmitter*.ColorOverLife` is sampled at. An immortal particle
    // (zero Lifetime) reads as fully aged.
    NormalizedAge(self: Particle3D): Number
        => SafeDivide(self.Age.Seconds, self.Lifetime.Seconds, 1.0).Saturate;

    // True while the particle has not reached its Lifetime.
    IsAlive(self: Particle3D): Boolean
        => self.Age.Seconds < self.Lifetime.Seconds;

    // True while the particle has not reached its Lifetime.
    IsAlive(self: Particle2D): Boolean
        => self.Age.Seconds < self.Lifetime.Seconds;

    //==
    // # Stepping a system
    //
    // Emission is deliberately absent. Spawning from a `ParticleEmitter*`
    // means drawing from the Speed / Lifetime / Size ranges it declares, which
    // needs a random stream threaded through the step and returned from it —
    // a different piece of work with its own state design. Everything below
    // steps the particles that already exist, which is what a simulation of a
    // fixed population (and every cloth) needs.

    // Every particle of a set advanced one step under a force set, with the
    // clock read in seconds.
    StepParticles(particles: Array<Particle3D>, forces: ParticleForces3D, time: Number, dt: Duration): Array<Particle3D>
        => particles.Map(p => p.Step(forces.AccelerationAt(p.Position, p.Velocity, time), dt));

    // One step of a whole spatial system: every particle advanced under the
    // system's own force fields, and the clock advanced with them.
    Step(self: ParticleSystem3D, dt: Duration): ParticleSystem3D
        => ParticleSystem3D(
            StepParticles(self.Particles, self.Forces, self.Time.SecondsSinceEpoch, dt),
            self.Emitters,
            self.Gravities,
            self.Drags,
            self.Vortices,
            self.Attractors,
            self.Turbulences,
            self.Winds,
            self.Time + dt);

    // One step of a whole planar system, with the spatial force fields read in
    // the XY plane.
    Step(self: ParticleSystem2D, dt: Duration): ParticleSystem2D
    {
        var forces = self.Forces;
        var time = self.Time.SecondsSinceEpoch;
        return ParticleSystem2D(
            self.Particles.Map(p => p.Step(forces.AccelerationAt(p.Position, p.Velocity, time), dt)),
            self.Emitters,
            self.Gravities,
            self.Drags,
            self.Vortices,
            self.Attractors,
            self.Turbulences,
            self.Winds,
            self.Time + dt);
    }

    // The system's particles that have not reached their Lifetime, in order.
    // Kept separate from `Step` so a caller that wants a fixed population — a
    // cloth, a debug scene — never loses one.
    LiveParticles(self: ParticleSystem3D): Array<Particle3D>
        => self.Particles.Reduce(self.Particles.Take(0),
            (kept, p) => p.IsAlive ? kept.Append(p) : kept);

    // The planar system's particles that have not reached their Lifetime.
    LiveParticles(self: ParticleSystem2D): Array<Particle2D>
        => self.Particles.Reduce(self.Particles.Take(0),
            (kept, p) => p.IsAlive ? kept.Append(p) : kept);
}
```
